title: The Forbidden City Opened in 1420. Its Biggest Hall? 1697 | China Travel Expert
description:
The Forbidden City opened its gates in 1420 — but its grandest building is younger than the palace around it. The Hall of Supreme Harmony (太和殿), the largest hall in the complex and the emperor's throne room, burned down again and again. After the last great fire under the Qing, it was rebuilt in the 1690s; the Palace Museum dates the hall standing today to 1697.

So when you cross that vast marble terrace on the central axis, the spot is the same one laid out in 1420 — but the timber above it is Qing-era, nearly 280 years younger than the city gates you walked through to reach it.

🧭 Expert Tip: Come right at opening and head straight up the central axis — you'll reach the Hall of Supreme Harmony before the tour groups do.

紫禁城 1420 年启用，但最大的太和殿是清代 1690 年代重建的——今天看到的木构，故宫博物院定为 1697 年。
